name: btf-migration
description: BikeTourFrance website: native Astro build deployed to Cloudflare Pages (project temp-btf) from GitHub.

scripts.build: npm run canonical:check && BTF_COPY_FIXTURE=1 npm run gallery:sync && BTF_COPY_FIXTURE=1 npm run copy:sync && npm run copy:validate && npm run copy:generate-ts && astro build && npm run copy:verify-rendered && npm run gallery:verify && npm run verify
scripts.copy:check-local: BTF_COPY_FIXTURE=1 npm run copy:sync && npm run copy:validate && npm run copy:generate-ts && npm run copy:verify-rendered
scripts.copy:production-pipeline: npm run gallery:sync && npm run copy:sync && npm run copy:validate && npm run copy:generate-ts && astro build && npm run copy:verify-rendered && npm run gallery:verify && npm run verify && node scripts/copy/assert-deployable.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run build && npm run verify && npm run copy:test && npm run gallery:test
